_doc: T-240: the undead horses (the owner: 'add boss zombie horses on round 20 and 30'). Loaded by HorseBoss.table() (not a GLData table). Which map gets which boss on which round is the map's own json: "round_bosses": [{"round": 20, "boss": "totenross", "count": 1}, ...] and "round_boss_arena": {"zones": [zone ids the horse may stand in and chase into], "arrive": [[x, y, z], ...] (where it comes in; omit: the far side of its zones), "exit": [x, y, z]}; HorseRound (gravelight/enemies/homage/horse_round.gd) reads them. DAS TOTENROSS (round 20) is a carters' dray horse long in the ground, still in its collar and traces, dragging a broken shaft; DER FUHRMANN (round 30) is the same horse, worse, with its dead carter on its back: he lashes with the whip until the horse is at rider.falls_at of its health, then he is thrown and fights on foot as an ordinary zombie (rider.hp_rounds x the round's zombie health, tier rider.tier). Numbers: hp_base is solo; HP = hp_base x (1 + hp_player_step x (players - 1)). Reasoning (docs/u15/t240_horses.md): a round-20 zombie has 2,710 health and the Foreman 50,000 at round 20, PAUL 30,000 at round 15; the horse has two weak points (the head x1.6, the lit gaps in the ribs x2.0) and a 2.6 s stagger at x1.5 every time it runs into a wall, so 46,000 at round 20 and 72,000 at round 30 sit between PAUL and the Foreman for what a squad holds by then (Crucible weapons). Damage against 100 health (250 with Ironhide): a charge 80, a stomp 60 / 30, a kick 55, a trample stomp 30, the whip 35; round 30 x1.2. Every attack is telegraphed (pose + sound + light, never under 0.5 s) and has a counter. phases: at each health fraction the speed, the cooldown scale and what changes in the arena. dread: the shared kit's block (docs/BOSS_REWORK.md 2.4). bots_alone mirrors cousins.json. siege: when nobody it may reach is left for wait_s it screams and the dead within radius run (every every_s): hiding indoors is not free. failsafe_seconds after it comes in it bolts away and comes back return_after rounds later until it is killed.

moves._doc: telegraph seconds (pose + sound + light); damage; cooldown seconds; ranges in metres; counter = how a player beats it.

charge.counter: side-step once the head goes down: the line is set before it runs; a wall staggers it

stomp.counter: back out of the ring, or be in the air as the hooves land

kick.counter: do not stand behind it; leave the cone when the ears go flat

trample.counter: teammates hit it for 2.5% of its health (or its ribs once) and it breaks off; get up and roll clear

siege._doc_perch: T-268: it cannot climb; each siege scream shakes every player standing on a platform a ladder serves (the watchtower) within perch_radius for perch_damage, and the dead it set running climb after them

whip.counter: step off the line when the arm goes up; it does not reach past 9 m
